pr.title: Link a pull request's Vercel preview in its drawer, between GitHub and its Projector summary
pr.head: 494734ddb1a7d6ac9e9ba6753035982682c6c71f

summary: Projector's panel in Claude Code and its terminal console both list the pull requests a session watches. Each row opens a drawer, a panel of details and links: open in github, and open in projector when a summary page exists. Vercel deploys a preview of each head for repositories it builds, such as this one's web/ site. Until now, reaching that preview meant opening the pull request on GitHub and finding Vercel's deployment there.
This change adds an open in vercel link between the other two. The console gives it the key d, for deployment. It appears only when the head commit has a successful Vercel preview.

Vercel's GitHub integration records each preview as a GitHub deployment on the head commit. The vercel bot creates the deployment, and the latest status of the deployment carries the preview's address in environmentUrl. The watch daemon's GraphQL query now asks for the head commit's last 10 deployments. Projector has two copies of the row model, TypeScript for the panel and Python for the console. Each picks the same deployment:

1. the vercel bot created it, so a GitHub Pages or hand-made deployment never counts;
  2. its latest status is SUCCESS, so a newer build that failed or is still running leaves the last good preview linked;
  3. its URL is http or https;
  4. it is the newest that passes, since GitHub lists a commit's deployments oldest first.

groups.title: The daemon asks GitHub for the head's deployments
groups.kicker: One more field in the watch daemon's pull request query
intro: The watch daemon is the background process that polls GitHub for every pull request a session watches, and caches each answer for the panel and the console to read. Its single GraphQL query now also reads deployments(last:10) on the head commit, with each deployment's creator and latest status.

files.note: Adds deployments to QUERY and explains it in the comment above.

checks.text: I ran QUERY against #607. It returned no errors and a cost of 2. It listed a vercel deployment and a ninjudd one, both SUCCESS, so the creator check is what keeps the second one out.

groups.title: Both row models pick the newest good preview
groups.kicker: The same rule in the panel's TypeScript and the console's Python
intro: A row model turns the daemon's cached answer into the fields a drawer shows. The panel reads it in hooks/github.ts and the console in src/projector/rows.py. The two are kept in step by shared fixtures under tests/fixtures/rows/ that run through both. Each gains a preview_url (previewUrl in TypeScript) that is null when no deployment passes the rule. Every existing fixture now expects preview_url: null.

checks.text: The two functions, previewOf and preview_of, must apply the same rule. The new case in facts.ts is what holds them together.

files.note: Adds previewOf and sets previewUrl from the head commit.

checks.text: to_pull is the only place that constructs Pull, so the new field, which has no default, cannot be left out elsewhere.

files.note: A head with six deployments: two good previews, then a failed one, a javascript: URL, one with no status, and a person's GitHub Pages deployment. The expected result is the second good preview.

groups.title: The drawer shows the link
groups.kicker: The panel's link row and the console's d action
intro: The panel renders open in vercel between the GitHub and Projector links. The console adds a d: Open in Vercel action in the same place, which opens the preview through the same visit path as o and p. Over SSH, visit shows the URL in place of opening a browser. The console already uses v to show and hide the conversation, so the action takes d.

files.note: Renders the link only when previewUrl is set.

checks.text: panel_key handles v and the navigation keys before a drawer's controls, and no other control uses d.

files.note: Checks that the links read github, vercel, projector, in that order.
Checks the console's action order and that d opens the preview.
